{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(data.head())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print(f"\nNumber of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Patients with duplicates: {list(duplicates.index)}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check for assay_batch unit error
print(f"\nUnique assay_batch values: {data['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check severity distribution
print(f"\nSeverity distribution:\n{data['severity'].value_counts().sort_index()}")"}
